# Sample credits

All samples come from **VSCO 2 Community Edition** by Versilian Studios, original files from the GitHub repository <https://github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE>, licensed **CC0 1.0 Universal** (public domain dedication): <https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/>. The repository's licence file: <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE/master/LICENSE>. Project page: <https://versilian-studios.com/vsco-community/>.

VSCO 2 CE was recorded by Sam Gossner and Simon Dalzell, with sample cutting by Elan Hickler / Soundemote. The upright piano was sampled by Simon Dalzell of Ivy Audio (its `Info.txt`: "Bearer is granted right to redistribute this sample set by Versilian Studios LLC. Credit to both original author and Versilian Studios is encouraged."). CC0 does not require credit; we give it gladly.

## Changes made for this project

Each note was mixed to mono, trimmed to start at the note, shortened (strings 6.5 s, piano 4.5 s, the two highest piano notes 3 s) with a fade-out at the end, adjusted in loudness so the notes match each other, and encoded as 80 kbps MP3. On the piano, a gentle noise gate lowers the recording hiss in the fading tails. Three notes were retuned slightly to equal temperament by resampling: violin C4 (−22 cents), piano C♯6 (−32 cents) and piano A6 (−41 cents; the original upright has the usual stretched tuning in its top octaves).
